thread:
incident-bot: Paging: High error rate detected in embeddings-service (us-west-2). 5xx spike and elevated latency. auto-page oncall.

sarah_oncall: saw the page, I'm up. looking at metrics now. roughly when did this start?

mike_sre: traces show CPU saturation on a subset of pods starting ~12:03 UTC. KV cache evictions also spiked.

wanda_support: we already have three customers opening tickets mentioning "embedding timeouts" — region us-west.

sarah_oncall: ok creating postmortem thread. can we roll a config to reduce max-concurrency on that pool as a quick mitigation?

mike_sre: can try scaling down concurrency + bump replicas. will submit a canary config to dedicated pool.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by mike_sre: reduce-concurrency-embeddings -> canary. started at 12:08 UTC.

lee_product_ops: heads-up — product teams relying on short-latency embeddings for search ranking. we'll need a status update for status.redwood.ai.

sarah_oncall: drafting status page note below, please edit inline.

sarah_oncall: ```Status: degraded
Component: embeddings-service (us-west-2)
Impact: increased latency and sporadic errors for embeddings generation; some requests may time out or return 5xx.
Start time: 2026-03-15 12:03 UTC
Mitigation: rolling canary to reduce per-worker concurrency; autoscaling triggered. Engineers are investigating root cause.```

mike_sre: looks good. add "Customers using Dedicated private pools may see less impact depending on routing".

wanda_support: can we also draft a customer notification template for affected customers and include SLA/credit language? I have a few pending support threads.

sarah_oncall: here's a short customer template — please proof: 

wanda_support: ```Hi <Customer name>,

We wanted to let you know that between 12:03–12:40 UTC today an operational issue affected the embeddings-service in us-west-2 which may have caused higher latency or 5xx errors for requests routed to that region. Our engineers deployed mitigations and normal service was restored at ~12:40 UTC.

We take reliability seriously — if your integrations experienced failure during this window we can assess eligibility for service credits per your SLA. To help us evaluate, please reply with any affected request IDs or a brief summary of impact (time windows, request volume, customer-facing impact).

Apologies for the disruption — we’re following up with a root cause analysis and any remediation we apply.

Best,
Redwood Support
```

sarah_oncall: that looks good. Wanda, can you also set expectation: credits are calculated per the SLA formula, and we'll escalate to billing if eligible.

wanda_support: noted. opening customer replies thread and attaching the above.

mike_sre: quick update: canary reduced 5xxs by ~80% on canary nodes, overall error rate trending down. still seeing elevated latency on cold KVs. planning a rolling restart of the remaining pods after 12:50 UTC if stable.

billing_ops: tagging in for credit eligibility checklist. Need: impacted window, total affected requests per customer (approx), and customer account tier.

sarah_oncall: recording metrics snapshot for billing: 

sarah_oncall: ```- Global affected window: 12:03–12:40 UTC
- Peak error rate: 14% 5xx on embeddings-service (us-west-2) at 12:12 UTC
- Approx affected requests: 18k across routed customers in region (est)
- Root mitigation: reduced concurrency canary -> restored baseline by 12:40 UTC
```

billing_ops: thanks. we'll run the SLA calc. for reference, please attach per-customer request counts in the support tickets — we'll need that to compute credits.

lee_product_ops: for internal comms, here's an ops-blurb we can push to the sales and AM teams: 

lee_product_ops: "We experienced a regional embeddings outage that affected latency and caused transient errors for some customers in us-west-2. Mitigation completed within ~37 minutes. Support has been notified and is collecting impact details for potential SLA credits. We're investigating root cause (KV eviction/CPU hotspot) and will share RCA when available."

wanda_support: FYI — customer AcmeCorp replied with logs and impacted request ids. attaching to ticket now.

mike_sre: can we run a quick sanity query to confirm KV eviction back to normal after restarts?

sarah_oncall: running check now... eviction rate back to baseline at 12:46 UTC.

billing_ops: starting preliminary credit eligibility pass. Will follow up with estimated credit amounts per account by EOD. Any customers on annual prepay will get a pro-rated credit handled via invoicing; pay-as-you-go customers will receive a billing adjustment.

wanda_support: drafting customer-facing credits wording for approved cases: 

wanda_support: ```Hi <Customer>,

Thanks for the details. Based on our review of the incident (12:03–12:40 UTC) and the impact you reported, you are eligible for a service credit under Section 4.2 of the SLA. We estimate a credit of <amount> applied to your next invoice. If you'd like a breakdown of how this was calculated, reply and we'll share the calc.

We apologize again for the disruption.

— Redwood Billing & Support
```

sarah_oncall: please keep internal thread updated with final credit amounts. I'll update status.redwood.ai to: "Mitigation in place, full service restored. Investigations ongoing; customer notifications sent where applicable."

deploy-bot: canary completed, rolling restart applied to remainder of replicas at 12:51 UTC.

mike_sre: root-cause hypothesis: memory pressure on the KV cache due to a rare request size spike + stale eviction policy. RCA in progress.

billing_ops: sending first-pass estimates to finance and support channel.

wanda_support: will triage incoming customer replies and mark tickets for credit handling.

sarah_oncall: final note for oncall handoff — handing to nightshift at 19:00 UTC. leave monitoring alerts enabled for embeddings-service us-west-2: error_rate > 2% for 5m.

mike_sre: leaving a short runbook snippet for night team: 

mike_sre: ```1) Check per-pod CPU and KV evictions\2) If 5xx > 2%: reduce concurrency and scale replicas
3) If error persists: rollback to last good config and notify eng-platform
4) If service restored: collect metrics snapshot and notify billing for final credit calc
```

wanda_support: thanks — will confirm handoff with oncall and close this thread once credits posted. :white_check_mark:
